title: Kiritani Haruka — Present For You!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Haruka's Room

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I'm glad our event succeeded.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (There are a few things that we need to work on, but we should be able to go into our next one with our heads held high.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But for now, I need to work on that segment for our next stream...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hm? A message...?
Oh, it's from Minori.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <I'd like to talk before practice tomorrow morning.> ...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Did something happen...?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I mean, I'll reply yes but...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (What does she want to talk about?)
The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Good morning.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-Haruka! Good morning!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Sorry about asking you to meet like this so suddenly.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, it's okay. Thirty minutes earlier than usual is no big deal.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But what is it that you want to talk about?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Right!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Putting on that event we just did really taught me that I still don't have enough knowledge or experience yet when it comes to these things.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I see now that what I sometimes think of as being good can be not so great for our fans. I wasn't able to see things from a different perspective before...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I can't believe someone's willing to help us like this! Now, our event might just...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Is this the right way to go?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: By agreeing to have this person help us, we'd be making them “work” instead of having fun, no...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: In other words, we'd be forcing our fans to face reality and see what goes on behind the scenes...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I want to do everything in my power to make sure our fans get to enjoy our events as fans.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I apologize for what I said that time, Minori. You were so optimistic and looking forward to everything, while I just...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What? N-No, don't worry about that!
I should be apologizing for not fully understanding how our fans would feel about what I said!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Also, well...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'd like to take more of that into consideration when we're planning for our next event.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So I want you to tell me more about where you think I need to be more careful moving forward!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, and I'll try my best to give you good feedback.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let me start by commending you on wanting to be more “careful” since it's a very important part of what we do.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's easy to miss things that you shouldn't be by not giving something the attention it deserves.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: In terms of knowledge, I can tell you about some things, but I gave a feeling that Airi's the better person to ask.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She was a regular on quite a few TV shows, so she probably knows more than any of us about how the production process really works.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right! I really appreciate it, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: As for experience, that's just going to take time for you to accrue.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, yeah... I guess so, huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I used to be the “zero experience amateur idol”, so I'm not about to let that get me down!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And I want to keep learning more about being an idol by gaining that experience with all of you!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
But Minori...
You do possess something really incredible.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! I... I do?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You have the ability to see things from the fans' perspective.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Because you'd spent so much time being my fan, you really know what the fans want.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's something the rest of us won't be able to achieve any time soon even if we tried.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I believe that the time you spent and the experience you gained as a fan, is just as important as the time the rest of us spent being idols.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So I really want you to be proud of having the ability to see things from the fans' perspective.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: When we're trying to think of ideas for our stream, Airi's always saying how, “It's important to see things from the fans' perspective.”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And now I understand. I actually have something to contribute...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Exactly. So I'd like it if you could also keep taking what you believe into consideration as well.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I believe you'll get to experience a whole variety of things before you know it if you do, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, I'll start by thinking about what I can do for us! Thank you so much, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm so glad I asked you about this.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Likewise.
Thank you as well for taking what I said so seriously.
